title: LOTR Journymap Bridge
description: LOTR-JourneyMap Bridge is a lightweight client-side Forge 1.7.10 utility mod that connects The Lord of the Rings Mod with JourneyMap.
body:
LOTR-JourneyMap Bridge is a lightweight client-side Forge 1.7.10 utility mod that connects The Lord of the Rings Mod with JourneyMap.

The mod displays compatible LOTR map location data, such as fellowship/member markers, through JourneyMap so players can see relevant LOTR tracking information in a more convenient minimap or fullscreen map view.

It only reads client-side map/location data already available to the player and renders a visual overlay on Journeymap.

Features:
- Bridges LOTR Mod map markers into JourneyMap
- Shows compatible fellowship/member location markers
- Works with JourneyMap’s minimap/fullscreen map display

This mod requires The Lord of the Rings Mod Legacy and JourneyMap.
